policy.note: Commons API extmetadata is rechecked for every selected original file. Runner audio and motion probing chooses seven moments from these CC0 candidates. Only original CC0 files with their own native audio streams are used; no transcodes, no separate audio assets, no audio substitution, and no added layers.
policy.selection: Seven moments are chosen by objective runner measurements; one-frame-per-second contact sheets are written for runner review records.
